entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Dorotheus of Sidon was a 1st-century Greek astrologer and astrological poet, who, during the Hellenistic Period, wrote a didactic poem on horoscopic astrology in Greek, known as the Pentateuch, surviving in Greek fragments and an Arabic translation by Omar Tiberiades.
